svg.text: ENTERPRISE LLM STRUCTURED OUTPUTS, XGRAMMAR FSM & REASONING-FIRST SCHEMA
100% Valid JSON in 410ms: Pre-Compiled XGrammar FSM + Reasoning-First Field Order
10M Structured Calls/Mo: Tier 1 Prompt-Only (11.8% Crash) vs. Tier 2 Retry Loop (3,120ms P99) vs. Tier 3 Answer-First (-16.5% Acc) vs. Tier 4 ($22K/mo)
⛔ Tier 1–3 Traps: Parse Crashes & Answer-First Drop
1. Prompt-Only JSON + Regex Strip (Tier 1: 11.8% Parse Crashes):
• Unescaped quotes, trailing commas & hallucinated enum strings
crash downstream Kafka/SAP consumers on 1.18M calls/month!
2. Client-Side Validation Retry Loop (Tier 2: 3,120ms P99 Lag):
• Re-prompting Pydantic errors without engine logit masking blows
up P99 latency by 2.8x and wastes +42% retry tokens
3. "Answer-First" Schema Field Order (Tier 3: -16.5% Accuracy!):
• Placing `verdict` before `reasoning` forces Token #5 to guess
Production Failure Impact (10M Structured Calls/Mo):
• Syntax Crash Rate: 11.8% (Tier 1) | Retry P99: 3,120ms (Tier 2)
• Answer-First Accuracy Drop (Tier 3): Plummets to 79.5% (-16.5 pts!)
• Monthly Compute & Pipeline Failure TCO: $168,000 / month
🏆 Tier 4: Cached XGrammar FSM + Reasoning-First Schema
1. Reasoning-First Schema Field Ordering (+16.5% Accuracy):
• Always define `evidence_quotes` & `step_by_step_analysis` FIRST,
and `final_decision_enum` LAST (96.0% task reasoning accuracy!)
2. Pre-Compiled XGrammar / Strict PDA Logit Mask (<0.15ms/tok):
• Masks invalid JSON/enum tokens in GPU sampler with 100.0% Pass-1
validity and zero cold grammar compilation stalls (410ms P99!)
3. Post-Decode Pydantic Semantic Invariant Check:
• Verifies cross-field math (`sum(items) == total`) deterministically
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks:
• First-Pass JSON Validity: 100.0% | Task Accuracy: 96.0%
• End-to-End P99 Latency: 410ms (7.6x faster than retry loops)
• Monthly Total TCO: $22,000 / mo (-86.9% savings vs. Tier 1)
